paragraphs: Rav Sharshya bar Idi: Ha-Kometz Zuta; see Rav Mesharshya. [Glosses: Sharshya. Yuhasin writes “Rav Sharshya bar Idi in Ha-Kometz Zuta.” It seems to me an error, for his name is Rav Mesharshya.]
